General.Name: Sterlite Technologies Limited
General.Description: Sterlite Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells telecom products in India and internationally. The company designs and manufactures optical fibres, optical fibre and specialty cables, and optical connectivity products. The company also provides multiverse and access network distribution solutions; and operates Neox communication platform. Sterlite Technologies Limited was founded in 1988 and is based in Pune, India.
